english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something no longer current or fashionable.
This is the all-purpose choice for something old-fashioned or no longer up to date.
This is the all-purpose choice for something outdated, including both unfashionable styles and obsolete equipment.
Use this when the emphasis is that an idea or attitude is no longer up to date, without necessarily mocking it.
Use this for an object, style, or idea that is no longer current or in vogue.
Use this when the style or design has gone out of date rather than simply looking uncool.
Use 過時 when the emphasis is that something is out of date or no longer fashionable.
Use 過時 specifically when something is outdated or no longer current, rather than merely old or previously owned.
